name: Solve this quantum programming problem. Using QuTiP, build a cat state (|alpha>
task_prompt: Solve this quantum programming problem. Using QuTiP, build a cat state (|alpha> + |-alpha>)/norm with alpha=2.15 in a 30-dimensional Fock space and print its Wigner function values on a coarse grid, identifying the interference fringes. The code must be a complete standalone script that can be executed directly and produces output.
